mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the next 60 days indicates the start of a monetary easing cycle, lowering discount rates and increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns.
regime_hint: early stage of monetary easing cycle
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or 60-day FEDFUNDS decline is not sustained beyond 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a risk-off reaction in equity markets, compressing discount rates and reducing the present value of expected equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in high-rate periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or FEDFUNDS > 4.5% is not sustained for > 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) over the next 60 days signals a strengthening labor market, which reduces the cost of capital and increases the present value of expected equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in strong-labor periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or 60-day PAYEMS growth is not sustained beyond 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 2% triggers a risk-on reaction in equity markets, compressing discount rates and increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in high-growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or PAYEMS > 2% is not sustained for > 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Industrial Production index (INDPRO) over the next 60 days indicates weakening aggregate demand, which raises real interest rates and compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in weak-demand periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or 60-day INDPRO decline is not sustained beyond 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) over the next 60 days signals deflationary pressure, which lowers real interest rates and compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in deflationary periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or 60-day CPIAUCSL decline is not sustained beyond 3 months.
